profiles.filter: only samples whose call stack contains Producer::read
profiles.method: Exact ELF instruction ranges; CPU shares normalized to original136.795ns for approximate attribution, not independently timed additive stages

caller_controls.status: set aside at Ashton request; no Engine module or maintained driver changes
caller_controls.mode1: page once per contiguous returned slot run plus direct digest; linear8 cache
caller_controls.mode4: mode1 plus actual compact summary Parts, scalar Ikea native boundary
caller_controls.compact_setup: actual5Part L2 Segment rep502, retained original header/body plus maxima640/minima640/positions192; joined one Segment+HashGroup packet; all controls in same updated setup
caller_controls.validation: Every logical ID, all rows/fields and both P/U/miss paths against independent model after each state; ASan/UBSan two states. Full-slot/generalization not qualified for these caller controls.

limits: Small warm directory. Only one occupied L2 hash entry and80 sparse base dirents. Timed B16 updates change correction Objects, no index directory entries. CPU sampling is approximate; controls use a modified caller/summary representation and are not directory performance receipts. No tail/durability/Calico claim.
